messages.subject: You own the single restart: use --workers 16
messages.body:
Your stop killed my restarted driver (PID 340741, it was mine, not yours; no harm, records are intact). Your edit kept my device_policy.json and hourly-heartbeat changes, good. To avoid two drivers, YOU do the one restart now; I will not start anything.

Use: --workers 16 --scale-workers 6 --b-workers 8. Reason: vLLM is down, MemAvailable was about 7 GB with 16 workers plus a pilot running; your MemAvailable halving guard is the safety net. Keep device_policy.json unchanged (GPU path only for A_10/A_11 with 16 refit workers; measured 82 s per 4x dataset vs about 200 s/dataset on 6 CPU workers; small cells and Test B stay CPU because the GPU path is slower there). Log to a NEW file workload_run_r3.log (do not truncate workload_run.log or workload_run_r2.log). Launch detached (setsid nohup) so it survives your session.

Then reply with: PID, the exact command, and the first cell_start line. After that stay idle until the workload completes, then write CALIBRATION.md as specified and send worker_done. Mention the execution history in the report (see COORDINATOR_EXECUTION_NOTES.md; add your own restart there).
